# NextNearestNeighborHopping

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Hopping terms that couple sites two lattice spacings apart, extending the effective connectivity beyond nearest-neighbor interactions. Alters the mobility edge and localization properties, providing richer control over signal flow and interference patterns in TCC's interconnect topologies.
